title: The influence of C–F⋯H–X hydrogen-bonding interactions on the reactivity and selectivity of organic reactions
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,9921-9938
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01269K, Review Article
Pengwei Xu, Xin Wang, Tao Wang, Zhong-Yan Cao, Jin-Sheng Yu, Jian Zhou
This tutorial review discusses the role of C–F⋯H–X hydrogen-bonding interactions in enabling new reactivity, as well as enhancing the regioselectivity and enantioselectivity of organic reactions.
